The grain of the screen is announced by the procedure the build has to file, so the architecture is spent: a re-root needs a decisive step that no filed sentence turns into a work order, and an ask layer whose devices are silent.

The solver attributed by the tap counter alone (DSL-T1 and LST-T2 acetylene at a constant ~0.6 ppm per 1,000 operations, excluded; RLS-T2 'in steps unrelated to ops') off 5.2's main-tank qualifier, which the confirming reader also planned; 5.2 stays for determinism, and the next rung makes that exact step return the wrong slate: RLS-T2's arc moves to the tap selector in the main-tank oil, so its acetylene tracks its counter as closely as a leak (r 0.999) and only the gas it arrives with (C2H2/H2 0.64 against 9.8 and 8.2) keeps it on the slate; tracking-only attribution now names SBG-T2, CGT-T1, SPN-T2 (rung 3b).
